assumptions: CLI `ssim-libvmaf` -> run_cpu_ssim_libvmaf (zenmetrics-cli metrics/mod.rs:3173-3192): studio601_y_plane (studio-swing BT.601 Y u8, metrics/mod.rs:277-ish; ~5 mul/add + round/clamp per px) -> u16 widen -> msssim::float_ssim (libvmaf.rs:553).

float_ssim_lcs (libvmaf.rs:569-603): hbd scale (8-bit = identity), OPTIONAL box decimate scale = max(1, round(min(w,h)/256)): 256->1 (none), 1024->4, 1920x1080->4, 3840x2160->8. Elements/ops express S; at S=1 the decimate stage is skipped by the impl but modeled with elements >=0 anyway (ceil dims / S^2 el x S^2 taps ~ S^2 work total -> at S=1 a no-op counted as a copy approx: (W/1)(H/1)*1 fma+mul -- slight overcount at 256 where impl skips; noted).

iqa_ssim (libvmaf.rs:451-513): conv_gauss_valid = separable 11-tap GAUSS (libvmaf.rs:36-40) on mu_r, mu_d, r2, d2, rd -> 5 convs; r2/d2/rd built by 3 elementwise muls on FULL planes (r.len(), not valid region).
Each conv: per out-el 11 ld + 11 fma per axis (conv_gauss_valid_inner:214-278) on (w-10)x(h-10) valid region; modeled on W*H (border ~1% overcount at 4K, ~7% at 256).
iqa_fold (libvmaf.rs:360-431): per valid el compute l = (2 mu1 mu2 + C1)/(mu1^2+mu2^2+C1), c, s similarly (~14 flops + 2 div) and 4 f64 accumulates (ssim,l,c,s) via striped bands.

stages.name: RGB8 -> studio-swing BT.601 u8 Y

stages.name: optional SxS box decimate (S=max(1,round(min/256)))
stages.notes: S^2 taps + normalize mul + u16->f32 cvt folded here. At S=1 impl skips; tally counts ~2 flops/px (harmless).

stages.name: per-el l/c/s maps + f64 accumulations
stages.notes: 3 rational terms (~9 mul + 6 add + 3 div) + 4 f64 acc adds (cvt+add each); f32-round mean once.
